checks.detail: All five finalized inputs matched the supplied SHA-256 bindings before review.
Authority, evaluator, tests, and config bindings match; evaluator is 979 lines, tests are 582 lines, and config is one canonical line.
Temporary-file fsync followed by a hard-link publication provides atomic create-once behavior; terminal-publication errors are propagated without a false terminal claim.
Capability, checker, workspace deletion, post-checker, final-hash, and terminal-publication paths receive meaningful focused coverage.
A raw-directory setup exception is re-raised by the outer guard without a terminal FAIL attempt even when the output directory remains usable.
The offline qualification path contains checker subprocesses but no model, candidate, judge, live-run, or network invocation.

findings.detail: After the PASS freeze is accepted, _qualify_started creates the output directory and then creates output/raw. If raw_root.mkdir raises while output remains usable, qualify sees that raw_root is not a directory and immediately re-raises. It therefore never makes the authority-required best-effort atomic terminal FAIL attempt at output/terminal.json. The focused tests do not exercise this setup boundary, so their PASS does not establish the authorized catchable-failure claim.
